only-organizer: Only the organizer can change the settings of {group}.
title: Settings

group-name.title: Group
group-name.label: Group name
group-name.help: Stays the same every year, like Family or The office.

time-zone.label: Time zone
time-zone.help: Gift day, reminders and scheduled draws follow this time zone.

edition.title: {edition}
edition.done: This edition is over, so it can't be changed anymore.
edition.name: Name of this edition
edition.draw-on-help: Names are drawn that morning. Leave it empty to draw them yourself.
edition.call-url-help: To unwrap together on a call on gift day.

avoid-previous.label: Not the same as last time
avoid-previous.help: Nobody draws the person they had last time. Nobody sees who that was, not even you.

people.title: People
people.in-edition: {count, plural, one {# person in this edition} other {# people in this edition}}
people.remove-before: {name} leaves the group and won't be in the draw. Their wishlist stays theirs.
people.remove-after: {name} leaves the group. The names are drawn already: their Santa gets someone else, everyone else keeps their giftee.
people.drawn: Names are drawn, so who's in can't change here anymore. People who join now are slotted in.
people.locked: It's locked in, so who's in can't change here anymore. People who join now are in too.

keep-apart-drawn: Names are drawn, so who's kept apart can't change for this edition.

danger.title: Danger zone
danger.description: Deleting the group removes it for everyone, with every edition. Everyone keeps their own wishlist.
danger.confirm-description: Everyone loses access to the group and its editions. This can't be undone.

errors.DATE_IN_PAST: Dates can't be in the past.
errors.DATES_OUT_OF_ORDER: The draw has to come before gift day, and wishlists and posting no later than gift day.
errors.INVALID_INPUT: Something doesn't look right. Check the fields and try again.
errors.ALREADY_DRAWN: Names are drawn already, so the draw date and "not the same as last time" can't change.
errors.AVOID_PREVIOUS: With "not the same as last time" a draw would be impossible for these people.
errors.EDITION_CLOSED: This edition is over, so it can't be changed anymore.
errors.EDITION_CHANGED: Someone changed this edition just now. Reload the page and try again.
errors.INTERNAL: Something went wrong on our side. Try again in a moment.
